name: Apollo
summary: Industrial humanoid in commercial pilots with automotive and logistics partners.
specs_note: height ~5'8" (172.7 cm), weight ~160 lb (72.6 kg), lift capacity ~55 lb (24.9 kg) from the Apptronik/Mercedes-Benz press release (2024-03-15). Autonomy level and DoF not stated there -> NULL.

deployments.summary: Commercial agreement to pilot Apollo in Mercedes-Benz manufacturing: delivering assembly kits to production lines and inspecting/ delivering totes of kitted parts.

evidence.source_title: Apptronik and Mercedes-Benz Enter Commercial Agreement to Pilot Apollo
